name: Still got a crush on you
A little love
copy: Just in case you forgot: I like you. A lot.

name: Pocket hug
copy: Keep this one for later.

name: First thought
copy: You were my first thought this morning.

name: On my way
copy: Shoes on. Keys found. Nearly there.

name: Door’s open
copy: Come in. The kettle’s on.

name: Small win
copy: Tell me one good thing about today.

name: Good night
copy: Sleep well, my favourite human.

name: Coffee run
copy: Want your usual?

name: Home safe
copy: Home safe. Your turn to check in.

name: Thinking of you
copy: No reason. Just you.

name: Lunch date
copy: Lunch together? My treat.

name: Rainy day
copy: I saved you the dry side of the umbrella.

name: Proud of you
copy: I saw how hard you worked for that.

name: Tiny reminder
copy: Unclench your jaw. Have a sip of water.

name: Meet me
copy: Same place, same two idiots?

name: Quiet company
copy: We can sit together and say nothing.

name: Miss your face
copy: Please return it to my general vicinity.

name: Your song
copy: That song came on. Guess who I thought of.

name: Fresh start
copy: Can we try that conversation again?

name: No rush
copy: Reply when you’ve got the energy.

name: Friday plans
copy: You, me, absolutely no plans?

name: Thank you
copy: That little thing you did meant a lot.

name: Permission slip
copy: One evening off. Signed, the pigeon.

name: Good luck
copy: Go do the thing. I’m rooting for you.

name: Wish you were here
copy: There’s a perfectly good space next to me.

name: Save me a seat
copy: Preferably the one next to you.

name: One more kiss
copy: I appear to have left without enough kisses.

name: Dinner vote
copy: I vote for takeaway and your company.

name: Your move
copy: I’ve made tea. You pick the film.

name: Open invitation
copy: Come bother me any time.

name: Special delivery
copy: What’s a pigeon’s favourite font? Wingdings.

name: Table for two
copy: I booked us a table by the window. Excellent crumbs.

name: Night shift
copy: Why did the owl miss the morning post? Wrong shift.

name: The bill
copy: A duck bought lip balm. Put it on my bill, it said.

name: Air mail
copy: I sent you a breeze. It was the lightest parcel I had.

name: Paperwork
copy: My paper plane got a desk job. Too much paperwork.

name: Moving day
copy: My houseplant moved out. It needed room to grow.

name: Birdwatching
copy: I tried birdwatching. The pigeon stared back. Awkward.

name: Hot date
copy: I took a calendar to dinner. It had plenty of dates.

name: At the gym
copy: I asked for a light workout. They handed me a lamp.

name: New leaf
copy: My salad promised to change. It turned over a new leaf.

name: Phone call
copy: My phone needed space. I deleted a picture of the moon.

name: Shelf life
copy: My library book got a promotion. It’s on the top shelf.

name: Baking news
copy: The bakery has gossip. Someone spilled the beans on toast.

name: The pecking order
copy: I let the pigeon order dinner. It picked everything.

name: Slow post
copy: My snail mail arrived tired. The stamp was uphill.

name: Magic trick
copy: I made a biscuit disappear. The trick required tea.

name: Big break
copy: My mug started acting. Its first role was a breakable extra.

name: Fine print
copy: I read the small print. It said: move closer.

name: A good fit
copy: My sock joined a dating app. Still looking for its match.

name: Movie night
copy: We watched a film about glue. I was stuck to my seat.

name: Room service
copy: The pigeon ordered breakfast in bed. Crumbs, obviously.

name: Bad timing
copy: My clock quit work. It wanted its own time back.

name: Undercover
copy: My duvet became a detective. It loves undercover work.

name: Short story
copy: A pencil wrote its memoir. It had a good point.

name: In training
copy: I taught my pigeon to fetch. It brought me an invoice.

name: Tall tale
copy: My ladder tells stories. Each one has another step.

name: Flower power
copy: I told my bouquet a secret. The tulips stayed sealed.

name: Sign here
copy: My parcel asked for my autograph. Fame at last.

name: Grounded
copy: Why was the paper plane grounded? Too many flights of fancy.
